timeline.title: Wholesale inflation jumps to 11.39%
timeline.line: September WPI is up from 9.92% in August as fuel, food and manufactured prices rise
more: Fuel and power inflation 25.85%; crude petroleum and gas up 57.32% YoY
Food index 8.66% vs 7.05%; manufactured goods at a series-high 9.76%
Comes after the RBI hiked the repo rate by 25 bp to 5.50% last week

src.title: IANS: India's wholesale inflation at 11.39% in September
